name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 138 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 29% more than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 138 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 29 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: The Israeli Defence Forces have declared a permanent presence in depopulated West Bank camps while also setting up polling stations in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria ahead of elections. Israel has approved a US firm to identify sites for handing over Hamas arms and is working with the Board of Peace on demilitarisation, while Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks. Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza, and Israel downgraded the UK consulate in Jerusalem over a West Bank trade ban. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den israelske forsvarsstyrken har erklært en permanent tilstedeværelse i avfolket Westbank-leirer samtidig som den oppretter stemmesteder i Gaza, Libanon og Syria før valgene. Israel har godkjent et amerikansk firma for å identifisere steder for overlevering av Hamas-våpen og samarbeider med Peace Board om demilitarisering, mens forsvarsminister Herzog sier at en større politistyrke er nødvendig for å dempe voldskriminalitet og bosetterangrep. Israelsk etterretningstjeneste har avslørt et politisk skifte som rettferdiggjør sivile tap i Gaza, og Israel har nedgradert det britiske konsulatet i Jerusalem på grunn av et handelsforbud i Westbank. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
